note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera, archive.org identifier dli.zoological.fi.026); the original is in English; the original description is in Akhtar 1975. The total body length of the soldier is not recorded in the original and is therefore omitted. The source pack continues from line 86 with the next species, Neotermes shimogensis, which was not used.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: head subquadrate (length to mandible base 1.65—1.70, width including eyes 1.80—1.86 mm), ocelli protruding and touching the compound eyes; pronotum wide (1.93—2.15 mm), distinctly broader than the head width including the eyes, anterior margin deeply concave; all the main veins of the forewing arise independently at the wing suture, the media sclerotised to the same degree as the radial sector and running parallel to it. Soldier: head subrectangular (length to mandible base 3.27—3.64, width 2.11—2.30 mm), mandibles long and stout with a pronounced swelling on the outer side of the base, mandible length about half the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.48—0.52), left mandible with 5 and right mandible with 2 marginal teeth; postmentum club-shaped with two lobes at the end, width at the waist 0.30—0.37 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown; frons, postclypeus, labrum and apical part of the antennae yellowish brown; pronotum and wings pale brown; legs paler. Head sparsely pilose, pronotum more densely so; anterior margin of the wings with short hairs. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandible base 1.65—1.70, width including eyes 1.80—1.86 mm); posterior margin rounded; frons gently inclined anteriorly; Y suture distinct, with a Y-shaped depression above it. Compound eyes subcircular, anterior margin truncate (maximum diameter 0.57—0.61, minimum diameter 0.52—0.57 mm); eye-antennal distance 0.50 mm. Ocelli protruding, touching the compound eyes, suboval (length 0.23—0.25, width 0.18—0.20 mm). Antennae 17—19-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 4 and 5 about equal in length. Mandibles of the Neotermes type, each with 2 marginal teeth. Postclypeus not clearly delimited from the frons, anterior margin with several hairs; anteclypeus trapezoidal. Labrum wider than long, anterior margin weakly concave, anterior margin and disc pilose. Pronotum pilose, subrectangular, broader than the head capsule including the eyes (length 0.95—1.08, width 1.93—2.15 mm); anterior margin deeply concave, posterior margin nearly straight with a weak median depression. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3. All the main veins of the forewing arise independently at the wing suture, the media sclerotised to the same degree as the radial sector and running closely parallel to it; cubitus weak, unsclerotised.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and antennal base pale reddish brown, frons and postclypeus darker, anteclypeus nearly white; labrum pale brown; mandibular base reddish brown, the rest nearly black; pronotum and abdomen brownish yellow; legs pale. Head and body sparsely pilose. Head capsule subrectangular (length to mandible base 3.27—3.64, width 2.11—2.30 mm); sides nearly parallel; frons inclined anteriorly, with a median depression; Y suture faintly visible. Compound eyes oval (maximum diameter 0.17—0.22, minimum diameter 0.10—0.12 mm); eye-antennal distance 0.20 mm. Antennae 13—14-segmented, segment 3 more strongly sclerotised and longer than segment 2, segments 4 and 5 about equal in length. Postclypeus not clearly delimited from the frons, margins and disc with several hairs; anteclypeus nearly white, narrow, hairless. Labrum wider than long, sides nearly parallel, anterior part tongue-shaped, disc and apex with several hairs. Mandibles long and stout, with a pronounced swelling on the outer side of the base; mandible length about half the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.48—0.52); left mandible with 5 and right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum club-shaped, widest anteriorly, narrowing posteriorly into a waist at about one third from the base; postmentum length 2.58—2.81, maximum width 0.76—0.83, width at the waist 0.30—0.37 mm; club bilobed. Pronotum wide (width 2.20—2.35 mm), slightly wider than the head; anterior margin deeply concave, without a notch; posterior margin nearly straight. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3.
